comment: Shared test vectors for the static part of LogRedactionManager's denylist (lib/utils/log_redaction_manager.dart) and its Dart port, pleya_verify/runner/lib/src/redact.dart. Both test/utils/log_redaction_manager_parity_test.dart (app side) and pleya_verify/runner/test/redact_test.dart (runner side) read this same file and check redact(input) == expected, so a pattern the app knows and the runner misses (or vice versa) fails on whichever side has not been updated to match. Registered-value redaction (registerToken/registerServerUrl) has no equivalent here — these vectors only exercise the always-on, pattern-based rules.

cases.description: a benign line with nothing to redact is untouched
IPv4 with dot separators is masked
IPv4 with dash separators is masked
Jellyfin Quick Connect secret query param
generic secret query param without a separator (the Tautulli apikey= case)
generic secret query param with an underscore before the field name
Bearer scheme credential keeps the scheme, drops the token
Cookie header is redacted wholesale via the credential-header fallback
an already-redacted Bearer value is left alone (idempotent)
an already-redacted Cookie value is left alone (idempotent)
a query string with no secret-shaped param is untouched
multiple secrets on one line are all redacted
